'''Matham''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] who served under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. He participated in the search for [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] when his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] crashed on the planet.<ref name="if" />
